# ModraDown (videodownloder.online)

> ModraDown is a zero-storage, high-speed online video downloader, Gemini AI watermark remover, and digital media archival utility suite. It provides ethical, browser-based extraction of public MP4 video streams and MP3 audio tracks directly from content delivery networks without requiring executable software or browser extensions.

## Core Services & Interactive Tools

- [Online Video Downloader](https://videodownloder.online/): Universal web utility to extract public videos in 1080p Full HD, 720p HD, and MP3 audio.
- [Gemini Watermark Remover](https://videodownloder.online/gemini-watermark-remover): AI optical-flow inpainting tool that automatically detects and removes logos, timestamps, and watermarks from short video clips and images.
- [YouTube Downloader](https://videodownloder.online/youtube-downloader): Tool to archive public Creative Commons and authorized educational videos in MP4 and MP3.
- [TikTok Downloader](https://videodownloder.online/tiktok-downloader): Tool to archive TikTok videos and creator b-roll without platform watermarks.
- [Instagram Downloader](https://videodownloder.online/instagram-downloader): Save public Instagram Reels, feed video clips, and creator stories.
- [Facebook Downloader](https://videodownloder.online/facebook-downloader): Tool to save public community videos and broadcasts.
- [Twitter / X Downloader](https://videodownloder.online/twitter-downloader): Save video tweets, breaking news clips, and animated GIFs.
- [Pinterest Downloader](https://videodownloder.online/pinterest-downloader): Save high-definition video pins and creative DIY tutorials.
- [Reddit Downloader](https://videodownloder.online/reddit-downloader): Extract video clips with synchronized audio streams.
- [Vimeo Downloader](https://videodownloder.online/vimeo-downloader): Download portfolio video showcases and independent short films.
- [AI Creative Tools & Utilities](https://videodownloder.online/tools): Suite of 100+ free online web tools (PixelDoc) for PDFs, images, text, and developers.

## Technical Architecture & Zero-Storage Guarantee

- **Protocol**: Direct-pipe CDN streaming over encrypted TLS 1.3/HTTPS.
- **Data Retention**: Zero server file storage. ModraDown never hosts, duplicates, caches, or logs user downloads on intermediate servers.
- **Supported Formats**: Universal MP4 container (H.264/AVC compression) and universal MP3 audio (up to 320kbps).
- **Compliance**: Fully compliant with DMCA safe harbor, Fair Use doctrines (17 U.S. Code § 107), and Google AdSense publisher policies. DRM bypass and access to private paywalled content are strictly prohibited.
